scripts.bundle: npm run download:plugins && npm run rebuild && theia build --mode production
scripts.bundle:dev: npm run download:plugins && npm run rebuild && theia build --mode development
scripts.watch: npm run rebuild && theia build --watch --mode development

config.//warnOnPotentiallyInsecureHostPattern: Off: the image sets THEIA_WEBVIEW_EXTERNAL_ENDPOINT to {{hostname}} on purpose (see theia/Dockerfile), and a person using the IDE can do nothing about it, so a warning on every open is noise. The session's entrypoint logs it instead, where whoever deploys it reads.

preferences.//files.watcherExclude: From Gearbox Studio's app. A session opens the gear corpus beside the project, and `target/` in a Rust checkout is gigabytes Theia would walk. `.gearbox/` is Generate's output, rewritten wholesale; gearbox-studio's views read it on demand and rely on it not being watched.
preferences.//ai-features.chat.toolConfirmation: From Gearbox Studio's app. The eight `@Gearbox` read tools return engine output and write nothing, so they run without a dialog; `gearbox_toggle_gear`, the one write, is absent and keeps the default `confirm`, on top of its own diff preview.
preferences.//files.exclude: Theia's own defaults, plus `.gearbox`: generated and disposable, and reached through the Generate and Lock views rather than the Explorer.
